description: Mint a NEW API key for the account registered on this machine and start using it. The key is sealed in the local encrypted vault and NEVER shown — the response carries only public facts (id, prefix, scopes, limits). Defaults to a sandbox key with the wallet scopes, the only set that always works. `merchant_read`/`merchant_write` (being paid by third parties) need a VERIFIED DOMAIN — call `verify_domain` first, which mints that key for you; asking for them without one is refused with domain_required. `live: true` needs the account to be graduated, else graduation_pending. Minting replaces the vault's key for that mode, so the OLD one keeps working at the server until you revoke it with revoke_key — and its local copy is gone, so revoke it or note the id from agent_status. Five keys per mode is the ceiling.

activate.description: Whether to make this MODE the active one. Omitted/true = yes. It cannot keep an older key of the SAME mode in use: the vault holds one key per mode, so minting into a mode always supersedes what was there. Use false only to mint for the other mode without leaving the one you are on.

daily_limit_cents.description: Daily ceiling in cents. wallet_write keys get a default if unset.

label.description: Human-readable label, for the operator's own key list.

live.description: true = production sk_live_ (requires graduation); omitted/false = sandbox sk_test_.

per_tx_limit_cents.description: Per-transaction ceiling in cents. wallet_write keys get a default if unset.

scopes.description: Scope set. Omitted = wallet_read + wallet_write. merchant_* requires a verified domain.

name: create_key

active_key_mode.description: Which key the server authenticates with now.

env_override.description: true when DEPIX_API_KEY shadows the new key.

key_id.description: The new key's id — what revoke_key takes.

warning.description: A loud note when the new key is not the one in use, else null.

title: Mint an API key for this account
